newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambican president to visit France.
newsitem.headline: Mozambican president to visit France.

text.p: Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano will begin a four-day visit to France on Monday intended to strengthen economic and cultural ties, the Mozambique News Agency said on Saturday.
The visit is at the invitation of President Jacques Chirac, with whom Chissano will hold talks in Paris on Wednesday.
French diplomatic sources in Maputo say France has provided Mozambique with aid of $50 million a year since 1990.
In 1995 French exports to Mozambique goods amounted to $30 million. France imported from Mozambique goods worth $4 million, mainly prawns and cashew nuts.
